snippet.title: Wake Up and Jump! - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wake Up and Jump! is a challenging retro platformer where precision matters. Dash through a cute but dangerous world, push your skills to the limit in this speedrun-oriented adventure and uncover secret stages… if you’re skilled enough.

Steam Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4168110/Wake_Up_and_Jump/

Release Date : January 2026
